obligation: NRC cyber attack notification: adverse impact
trigger: Cyber attack that adversely impacted safety-related, important-to-safety, security, or emergency preparedness functions (including offsite communications), or compromised support systems resulting in such impacts
deadline: Within 1 hour after discovery
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS (commercial telephone backup in appendix A to Part 73)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)
notifying_entity: Nuclear Generation (fleet security director, with the station CST and shift manager)

obligation: NRC cyber attack notification: could have impacted
trigger: Cyber attack that could have caused an adverse impact to those functions or could have compromised support systems (for example, malicious content staged on the kiosk update path)
deadline: Within 4 hours after discovery
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)
notifying_entity: Nuclear Generation (fleet security director, with the station CST and shift manager)

trigger: Suspected or actual cyber attack initiated by personnel with physical or electronic access to systems within the scope of 73.54
deadline: Within 4 hours after discovery
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)
notifying_entity: Nuclear Generation (fleet security director, with the station CST and shift manager)

obligation: NRC notification after notifying another agency
trigger: Notification to a local, State, or other Federal agency (for example the FBI) of an event related to the cyber security program for systems within the scope of 73.54 that does not otherwise require a 73.77(a) notice
deadline: Within 4 hours after the notification to the other agency
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations). Any group report to the FBI or CISA about station systems must go through the fleet security director (POL-03 4.4)
notifying_entity: Nuclear Generation (fleet security director, with the station CST and shift manager)
clock_starts: The time the other agency was notified

obligation: NRC notification: intelligence gathering or pre-operational planning
trigger: Information on observed behavior, activities, or statements that may indicate intelligence gathering or pre-operational planning for a cyber attack on systems within the scope of 73.54 (for example phishing that asks for CDA details, or bulk reads of CDA work packages)
deadline: Within 8 hours after receipt or collection of the information
notify: NRC Headquarters Operations Center via ENS
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)
notifying_entity: Nuclear Generation (fleet security director, with the station CST and shift manager)
clock_starts: Receipt or collection of the information

obligation: CAP record of a cyber security program weakness
trigger: Vulnerability, weakness, failure, or deficiency in the 73.54 cyber security program
deadline: Within 24 hours of discovery
notify: Station corrective action program (record, not a notice)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)

trigger: Any notification made under 73.77(a)
deadline: Within 24 hours
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)

trigger: Telephonic notification made under 73.77(a)(1), (a)(2)(i), or (a)(2)(ii) (not required after (a)(2)(iii) or (a)(3) notices)
deadline: Within 60 days of the telephonic notification, on NRC Form 366
notify: NRC (per 73.4) with a copy to the Director, Office of Nuclear Security and Incident Response
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations)

trigger: Declaration of an emergency class under the station emergency plan (for example if a cyber attack degrades plant functions)
deadline: Immediately after notifying State and local agencies and not later than 1 hour after the declaration
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations) (only if an emergency class is declared)

trigger: Declaration of Alert, Site Area Emergency, or General Emergency
deadline: As soon as possible but not later than 1 hour after the declaration
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations) (only if Alert or higher is declared)

obligation: Major loss of emergency assessment or communications capability
trigger: Event that results in a major loss of emergency assessment, offsite response, or offsite communications capability
deadline: Within 8 hours of the occurrence
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation (all 3 stations) (if business-network effects reach emergency communications)

obligation: NERC CIP Reportable Cyber Security Incident
trigger: Determination under the CIP-008 plan that a Reportable Cyber Security Incident occurred on the fleet operations center (medium impact BES Cyber System or its EACMS)
deadline: Within 1 hour after the determination
notify: E-ISAC and CISA (named in the standard as NCCIC)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation fleet operations center

trigger: Determination that a Cyber Security Incident was an attempt to compromise a medium impact BES Cyber System or its EACMS (for example scanning of the EACMS from a compromised corporate host)
deadline: By the end of the next calendar day after the determination
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation fleet operations center

trigger: New or changed information on functional impact, attack vector, or level of intrusion
deadline: Within 7 calendar days of determining the new or changed information
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Nuclear Generation fleet operations center

obligation: Part 37 actual or attempted theft, sabotage, or diversion
citation: 10 CFR 37.57(a), through the Florida license condition
trigger: Unauthorized entry that resulted in actual or attempted theft, sabotage, or diversion of the category 2 vault material (including sabotage of vault security systems by cyber means)
deadline: LLEA immediately; regulator as soon as possible after initiating a response and not later than 4 hours after discovery
notify: Local law enforcement; Florida Department of Health, Bureau of Radiation Control (the license condition reads NRC as the Department)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Radioactive Waste Management, Florida facility only
notifying_entity: Radioactive Waste Management (Florida facility Radiation Safety Officer)

citation: 10 CFR 37.57(b), through the Florida license condition
trigger: Suspicious activity related to possible theft, sabotage, or diversion (for example an unexplained loss of vault monitoring during a cyber attack)
deadline: LLEA as appropriate; regulator as soon as possible but not later than 4 hours after notifying the LLEA
notify: Local law enforcement; Florida Bureau of Radiation Control
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Radioactive Waste Management, Florida facility only
notifying_entity: Radioactive Waste Management (Florida facility Radiation Safety Officer)

citation: 10 CFR 37.57(c), through the Florida license condition
trigger: Telephonic notification made under 37.57(a)
deadline: Within 30 days
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Radioactive Waste Management, Florida facility only
notifying_entity: Radioactive Waste Management (Florida facility Radiation Safety Officer)

citation: 10 CFR 37.81(b), through the Florida license condition
trigger: Determination that a category 2 shipment is lost or missing (for example after a telematics outage)
deadline: Within 4 hours of the determination
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Radioactive Waste Management (shipments from the Florida facility)

trigger: Registrant determines a cybersecurity incident is material
deadline: Within 4 business days after the materiality determination (delay only on a U.S. Attorney General determination)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: group (SEC registrant)
clock_starts: Materiality determination, made without unreasonable delay

obligation: SEC Regulation S-K Item 106 annual disclosure
trigger: Annual report
deadline: With the annual report on Form 10-K
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: group

citation: Each state where affected individuals reside
trigger: Breach of personal information of state residents (definitions vary by state)
deadline: Varies by state
notify: Affected residents; state attorney general or regulator where required; consumer reporting agencies above state thresholds
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: all divisions (employee, contractor, outage worker, and customer data)
notifying_entity: Each division with Group General Counsel

trigger: Breach of security affecting Florida residents' personal information held by a covered entity (for example contractor access authorization files)
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination of a breach or reason to believe one occurred (15-day extension for good cause applies only to this notice)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: any division that is the covered entity for the data
notifying_entity: Division that owns the data, with Group General Counsel

obligation: Florida notice to the Department of Legal Affairs (worked example)
trigger: Breach affecting 500 or more Florida individuals
deadline: No later than 30 days after the determination (no extension)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: as above
notifying_entity: Division that owns the data, with Group General Counsel

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies (worked example)
trigger: Notice to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
deadline: Without unreasonable delay
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: as above

trigger: Breach of personal information that the dosimetry service maintains for a customer licensee (names, dates of birth, Social Security numbers of monitored individuals)
deadline: As expeditiously as practicable but no later than 10 days following the determination of the breach or reason to believe it occurred
notify: Each affected customer licensee (the covered entity), which then makes its own notices
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Engineering and Radiation Services (dosimetry service)
notifying_entity: Engineering and Radiation Services (dosimetry laboratory director)

trigger: Confirmed security incident affecting customer data or dose processing
deadline: Within 72 hours of confirmation (contract term)
notify: Each affected customer licensee's radiation safety officer
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Engineering and Radiation Services (about 2,100 customers)
notifying_entity: Engineering and Radiation Services (dosimetry laboratory director)

citation: Engineering services contracts with 14 external utilities
trigger: Incident affecting client engineering data, client SGI, or access authorization files the client relies on under 73.56(a)(4)
deadline: Per each contract (register kept by the Engineering and Radiation Services security and compliance lead); clients may have their own 73.77 decisions to make, so notify without delay
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Engineering and Radiation Services
notifying_entity: Engineering and Radiation Services (security and compliance lead)

trigger: Incident involving a division worker, laptop, or account that has station access
deadline: Immediately on suspicion (internal; supports the station 73.77 clocks)
notify: Fleet security director and the station CST
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Engineering and Radiation Services; Radioactive Waste Management

obligation: Covered telecommunications equipment or services discovered
trigger: Contractor identifies covered telecommunications equipment or services in use or delivered under a federal contract
deadline: Within 1 business day of identification; further report within 10 business days
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: Engineering and Radiation Services and Radioactive Waste Management DOE contracts

trigger: Contractor identifies a covered article (Kaspersky Lab hardware, software, or services) in use or delivered
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further report within 10 business days
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: DOE contracts in both service divisions

trigger: Contractor identifies a covered article subject to a FASCSA order, where the contract includes the clause
deadline: Within 3 business days of identification; further report within 10 business days
applies_at_this_tier: Applies only to DOE contracts that include 52.204-30

trigger: Incident affecting Federal Contract Information or DOE project systems
deadline: Confirm in each contract before use (not verified in this sample; FAR 52.204-21 itself sets no reporting clock)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: DOE contracts in both service divisions

obligation: OFAC sanctions check before any ransom payment
citation: OFAC Updated Advisory on Potential Sanctions Risks for Facilitating Ransomware Payments (2021-09-21); 31 CFR ch. V
trigger: Considering a ransomware payment
deadline: Before any payment; full and timely reporting to law enforcement or CISA is a mitigating factor
notify: OFAC (license if a sanctioned party is involved)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: group
notifying_entity: Group (board risk committee; Group General Counsel)

obligation: Voluntary report to law enforcement and CISA
trigger: Severity 1 incident
deadline: As soon as practical, but only through the fleet security director when station systems are involved, because the report can start the 73.77(a)(2)(iii) clock
notify: FBI field office or IC3; CISA
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: group
notifying_entity: Group CISO with the fleet security director

obligation: CIRCIA covered cyber incident and ransom payment reports (PROPOSED, not in effect)
trigger: Covered cyber incident or ransom payment (as proposed)
deadline: Proposed: 72 hours after reasonable belief; 24 hours after a ransom payment. Not in effect; final rule not published as of 2026-09-25
applies_at_this_tier: Not applicable until a final rule takes effect

trigger: Electric emergency incident or disturbance
deadline: Not required: the instructions exclude commercial power reactors regulated by the NRC and subject to Part 73 event notifications; no division is a Balancing Authority, Reliability Coordinator, or electric utility
applies_at_this_tier: Not applicable

trigger: Severity 1 incident or a potential claim
deadline: As the policy requires (notice before engaging most vendors)
applies_at_this_tier: Applies: group
